# Progress Animation

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Feedback

Feed identical measured values into two determinate progress views, adding an animation only to the bar that should interpolate between those updates.

- Before: Progress jumps between values
- After: Progress animates between values

APIs: `ProgressView`, `animation(_:value:)`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present ProgressDoExample() in your app.
struct ProgressDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            ProgressDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct ProgressDoContent: View {
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        VStack(spacing: 12) {
            ProgressView("Importing photos", value: Double(phase % 5), total: 4)
                .animation(reduceMotion ? nil : .linear(duration: 0.5), value: phase)
            Text("\(phase % 5) of 4 photos").monospacedDigit()
        }
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
